_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).

events.label: Portugal takes Ceuta
events.desc: A Portuguese fleet captures Ceuta in North Africa, the usual starting point of Portuguese overseas expansion.

events.label: Gil Eanes passes Cape Bojador
events.desc: A Portuguese ship rounds the cape that had been the southern limit of European sailing on the African coast.

events.label: Bartolomeu Dias rounds the Cape of Good Hope
events.desc: Dias sails around the southern tip of Africa.

events.label: Columbus reaches the Bahamas
events.desc: Columbus's first voyage, sailing for Castile, makes landfall in the Caribbean.

events.label: Treaty of Tordesillas
events.desc: Castile and Portugal divide the newly found lands along a line in the Atlantic.

events.label: John Cabot reaches North America
events.desc: Cabot, sailing from Bristol for Henry VII, lands on the North American coast.

events.label: Vasco da Gama reaches Calicut
events.desc: The first voyage from Europe to India by sea.

events.label: Cabral reaches Brazil
events.desc: A Portuguese fleet bound for India lands on the coast of Brazil.

events.label: Waldseemüller map names America
events.desc: Martin Waldseemüller's world map is the first to use the name America.

events.label: Portugal takes Goa
events.desc: Afonso de Albuquerque captures Goa, which becomes the centre of Portuguese India.

events.label: Portugal takes Malacca
events.desc: Albuquerque captures Malacca, the key port on the strait.

events.label: Balboa sights the Pacific
events.desc: Balboa crosses the Isthmus of Panama and sees the Pacific Ocean.

events.label: Magellan's fleet leaves Spain
events.desc: Five ships under Ferdinand Magellan sail from Sanlúcar de Barrameda.

events.label: Battle of Mactan
events.desc: Magellan is killed in the Philippines.

events.label: Fall of Tenochtitlan
events.desc: Cortés and his Indigenous allies take the Aztec capital.

events.label: First circumnavigation completed
events.desc: The Victoria, under Juan Sebastián Elcano, returns to Spain with 18 men.

events.label: Battle of Cajamarca
events.desc: Pizarro captures the Inca emperor Atahualpa.

events.label: Jacques Cartier explores the Gulf of St. Lawrence
events.desc: Cartier's first voyage for France.

events.label: Portuguese reach Japan
events.desc: Portuguese traders land on Tanegashima.

events.label: Spanish settlement of the Philippines begins
events.desc: Legazpi founds a settlement at Cebu; the Manila galleon trade follows.

events.label: Drake begins his circumnavigation
events.desc: Francis Drake sails from Plymouth; he returns in 1580.

events.label: First recorded European landing in Australia
events.desc: Willem Janszoon in the Duyfken charts part of Cape York.
